description: This header file declares the class 'DobbySpecGenerator' which is responsible for generating a JSON specification for runtime configuration, including methods for creating environment variables, mounts, plugins, and various runtime limits, based on application configuration and runtime settings.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class that encapsulates logic to generate runtime JSON specifications based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the runtime specification based on provided application and runtime configuration objects.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates a JSON array/object of environment variables from configuration data.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates a JSON array/object representing mount points based on configuration.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for RDK plugins based on current configuration.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for minidump plugin.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for App Service SDK plugin based on configuration.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for network plugin setup.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a JSON representation of a bind mount with given source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines whether GPU should be enabled based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves system memory limit for runtime based on configuration.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves GPU memory limit for runtime based on configuration.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU is enabled in current configuration.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing the number of CPU cores.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates JSON specifying classic plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ethan log plugin.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for multicast socket plugin.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ion memory plugin.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Thunder plugin based on configuration.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for OpenCDM plugin based on configuration.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates JSON for private data mount based on runtime configuration.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates Fkps mounts within the specification.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a temporary filesystem mount with specified destination and options.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates JSON for resource manager mount.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs the working directory based on configuration.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes JSON data related to Ion heaps.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string for safe inclusion in JSON or configuration.
